title: Detailed alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bells -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='12' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='8' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='12' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='8' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='18' y='11' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <rect x='70' y='11' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='3' fill='#FFF3E0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='3' fill='#FFF3E0'/>
  <!-- hammer between bells -->
  <rect x='48' y='8' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='5' fill='#90A4AE'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='34' fill='#EF5350'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#FF8A80' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='27' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#FFCDD2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hour ticks -->
  <rect x='49' y='33' width='2' height='5' fill='#37474F'/>
  <rect x='49' y='78' width='2' height='5' fill='#37474F'/>
  <rect x='25' y='57' width='5' height='2' fill='#37474F'/>
  <rect x='70' y='57' width='5' height='2' fill='#37474F'/>
  <rect x='32' y='40' width='4' height='2' transform='rotate(45 34 41)' fill='#78909C'/>
  <rect x='64' y='40' width='4' height='2' transform='rotate(-45 66 41)' fill='#78909C'/>
  <rect x='32' y='74' width='4' height='2' transform='rotate(-45 34 75)' fill='#78909C'/>
  <rect x='64' y='74' width='4' height='2' transform='rotate(45 66 75)' fill='#78909C'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='49' y='42' width='3' height='17' rx='1.5' fill='#263238'/>
  <rect x='49' y='52' width='15' height='3' rx='1.5' transform='rotate(40 50 58)' fill='#263238'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='3' fill='#EF5350'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='24' y='88' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='66' y='88' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='20' y='93' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <rect x='62' y='93' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
</svg>
